preconditions.description: The input contains exactly T testcases, each consisting of two lines (A and B), following the initial line containing T.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) and 1 <= len(A) <= 10**5 for A, B in zip(lines[1::2], lines[2::2]))
preconditions.description: For every testcase, strings A and B have equal lengths between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in s) for s in lines[1:])
preconditions.description: All strings A and B consist only of binary characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each testcase.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == sum(1 for k in range(n) if all((int(A[j]) ^ int(B[(j + k) % n])) == 0 for j in range(n))) for i, (A, B) in enumerate(zip(lines[1::2], lines[2::2])) for n in [len(A)])
postconditions.description: For each testcase, the output line contains the count of cyclic shifts k of B such that the bitwise XOR of A and the k-th cyclic shift of B results in a string of all zeros.
